title: AI领涨格局松动：资金暗中调仓，市场风向要变了？
speaker: Chris Weston

segments.en: risk and price that certainty, and that's why we're just very, very confusing at the moment.
segments.zh: 风险与价格的不确定性，这就是当前市场令人困惑的原因。

segments.en: We've just got to follow price.
segments.zh: 我们只能跟随价格走势。

segments.en: Chris, something that's somewhat different this time compared to, let's call it late March, the whole of April, is that when you look at, so AI managed to keep the boat afloat
segments.zh: Chris，这次与3月底、整个4月相比有所不同，AI板块曾支撑市场。

segments.en: when you look at, on an index level, very, very simply, AI started to rotate, we started to see some wobbles there.
segments.zh: 从指数层面看，AI板块开始轮动，出现了一些波动。

segments.en: Why do you think we are getting that reaction in the equity markets, or am I just overthinking the connection there?
segments.zh: 为什么权益市场会有这种反应，还是我想多了？

segments.en: No, I think you're wise in that assumption.

So I think probably what the thing is is that, yeah, when you've got that narrow leadership that concentration in breadth is that we saw this, the index being fairly well supported because the heavyweights were controlling us.
segments.zh: 我认为，当市场领涨板块过于集中时，指数因权重股支撑而表现稳健。

segments.en: Now, what we're seeing obviously is this idea of broadening a ownership, and people are looking not just within styles and factors, but within AI itself, so where do we want to go?
segments.zh: 现在我们看到的是持仓的分散化，人们不仅在风格和因子间调整，也在AI内部寻找方向。
